limitations: Three-site, one-excitation Markovian model with site-2 input, site-2 detuning, uniform pure dephasing and sink rate equal to hopping; only the mean first-capture time.
scientific_integrity: The rational mean-time formula follows from exact Liouvillian inversion; a global polynomial-positivity certificate proves strict convexity and unique, detuning-monotone positive optimal dephasing. Clean-middle transport was previously published; best-of-knowledge priority is limited to the arbitrary-detuning global optimizer and its monotonicity.
title: Strict convexity and a detuning-monotone noise optimum for a middle-initialized quantum trimer
